title: fix(metadata-protocol): the layered read on a base's address answers an email template locale its `.custom` pair adds with the pair's layer (#28830)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XNUzphnasmraGeKrcFVQSpZ)_

Fixes #28830

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：邮件模板的分层视图（`/meta/email_template/<名称>/layers`）按基础包名或不带包名读取时，客户在 `BASE.custom` 里新增的语言（基础包没有的，比如 showcase 只发 `en-US`，客户加 `fr-FR`）现在返回配对包那一层（`code` 为空、`overlay` 与 `effective` 是客户的模板），和按名读取、列表、发信一致；依赖包新增的语言在基础包地址下仍是 404，按依赖包名读取才有。
- **为什么改**：PR #28828 之后，配对包新增的语言在按名读取、列表和发信里都由基础包地址提供，只有分层视图还是 404，作者在后台看不到自己改了什么（#28830，PR #28828 合同复核提的「分层读取」标记）。
- **风险与回滚**：低。只改读取侧的一处分支，复用 #28828 已有的同一判定（`pairOfAddedMember`），只在名单类型（`ITEM_KEY_DISCRIMINATORS`，目前只有 `email_template`）且某语言基础包不发时才生效；其它类型字节不变，写入闸门不变。回滚即撤销本 PR。
- **先看**：`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts` 的 `[#28830]` 一处（`getMetaItemLayered`）和新的私有方法 `findPairAddedMemberRow`（按名读取与分层读取共用的一次读取）。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood exec vitest run test/email-template-dependent-unshipped-locale-read.dogfood.test.ts`，预期 12/12 通过（main 上 2 红）。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。

## What changes

Since PR #28828 (option A of #28779, ruling A on #28390), a base's address serves an email template member its `.custom` pair adds at a locale the base does not ship: the by-name reads naming the base or no package, the env-wide and base-scoped lists, `getMetaItemsForExecution` and `sendTemplate`. The layered read did not: `GET /meta/email_template/<name>/layers?package=<base>&member=fr-FR` answered `404` (no code layer, since the base ships no `fr-FR`, and no overlay, since the served-row candidates of the base's address hold no row at that member). ADR-0146 D8 lists the reads that must agree; this brings the layered read in line.

| layered read on the base's address (`?package=BASE` or no package) | before | after |
|:--|:--|:--|
| base's own member (`en-US`) | `code`: base, `overlay`: null | unchanged |
| pair's declared override (`en-US`) | `code`: base, `overlay`: override | unchanged |
| pair's own added member (`fr-FR`) | `404` | **`code: null`, `overlay`/`effective`: the pair's row** |
| a dependent's added member (`fr-FR`) | `404` | `404` (unchanged; answers under `?package=DEPENDENT`) |
| pair and dependent both at `fr-FR` | `404` | **the pair's** |
| any non-bundle type | as before | unchanged (the branch needs a bundle member) |

**`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts`.**

- `getMetaItemLayered`: when the served-row resolution finds no row and the read addresses a bundle member on a package's address, the pair's own row at that member is the overlay, read by `findPairAddedMemberRow`. `code` stays as resolved (null: the base ships no such member), so `effective` is the pair's row.
- `findPairAddedMemberRow` (new, private): the one read of the pair's row at an added member. It asks PR #28828's `pairOfAddedMember` (the base ships the name and not the member, else `undefined`) and then `findServedOverlayRow` naming the pair. `readMetaItem`'s #28802 branch now calls it too, so the by-name read and the layered read share one predicate and one read (behaviour of the by-name read unchanged: its suite and both test files stay green).
- Another package's member never answers here: `pairOfAddedMember` names only the base's `.custom` pair, so a dependent's row is not read on the base's address.

## Tests

- `packages/qa/dogfood/test/email-template-dependent-unshipped-locale-read.dogfood.test.ts` (real showcase over HTTP, `showcase_task_done_email`): a `layers(member, pkg?)` probe on the rig and 2 new cases, plus layered assertions folded into 2 existing ones.
  - Pair: the layered read naming the base, naming no package and naming the pair answers `{code: null, overlay: pair's subject, effective: pair's subject}` for `fr-FR`; the base's `en-US` layers unchanged.
  - Dependent: `fr-FR` stays 404 on the base and package-less layered reads and answers under `?package=DEPENDENT`; base `en-US` unchanged.
  - Pair beside dependent at `fr-FR`: the base's layered read answers the pair's.
  - Control: the pair's declared `en-US` override answers `{code: shipped, overlay: override, effective: override}`, and `fr-FR` on the base with only that override stored is 404.
  - RED on main `1920e480`: 2 failed / 10 passed (the pair case and the pair-beside-dependent case). GREEN at `c53513be`: 12/12 (os-verify-lock VERDICT command-exit 0).
- `packages/objectql/src/protocol-bundle-member-base-address.test.ts` (real protocol, real engine, in-memory driver): a `layersOf` helper and a `[#28830]` describe with 4 cases: the pair's added member on the base, package-less and pair addresses; a dependent's member 404 on the base and answered under the dependent; pair and dependent at one locale; control (declared `en-US` override, and a non-bundle `view` answering `{code: base columns, overlay: null}` as before). GREEN 10/10 at `c53513be`.
- Ablation, one leg (the seam): `if (row) served = { row };` → `void row;` through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor 1 → 0, restore blob == HEAD verified), `metadata-protocol` rebuilt and the mutation proved absent from `dist/` by `ablation-dist-preflight.mjs --absent`. Unit: 2 red (the pair's added member; pair beside dependent), 8 green. Dogfood: 2 red (the same two), 10 green. The dependent cases and every control stay green. A restore build followed, the marker proved present again.
- Package suites at this head: see Verification.

## Acceptance notes

- **The `version` token (measured, not changed).** On main `1920e480`, showcase, pair-added `fr-FR`: the by-name read naming the base answers `version: null`; the package-less and pair-named reads answer the pair row's token (`hmac-sha256:a8a29081…`); the base's own `en-US` read naming the base answers `null` (no stored row at the base's address). `version` is `readVersionToken` at the request's address, so naming the base it reads the base's row at `fr-FR`, which does not exist. Not the same seam (the token is the OCC pin of a save at that address, and a save naming the base at a member only the pair adds is the write gate's question), so it is not changed here; reported for the seat.
- **`Metadata-protocol: none`.** Nothing an author can write changed (no key, value or metadata type added or refused) and no meaning changed: what a pair-added locale means on the base's address was decided by #28828; this read now reports it. Changeset `patch`.
- **Stamp.** The layered read reports layers, not a `_packageId` stamp of its own; the `overlay` is the pair's stored document as stored.
- **`overlayRow`** (what `declinesStoredRow` judges a shipped flow name on) is set from the pair's row too; it only matters for `flow`, which is no bundle type.
- **Overlap re-read** before `pr_create`: open PRs touching `packages/metadata-protocol/src/` are #28731 (`protocol.ts`, the by-id OCC comparison near line 14450), #28764 (`metadata-redaction.ts`) and #28838 (one test file). `git merge-tree` against this head: no conflict with any; none touches `readMetaItem`, `getMetaItemLayered` or the #28802 helpers. Seat 1's #28831 (the per-package layer's provenance) has no open PR yet.

## Verification

Package suites at `c53513be`: `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` typecheck + test (297 files passed, 4 skipped; 22080 tests passed), `@objectstack/objectql` typecheck + test (521 files, 10008 tests passed), both under the lock, VERDICT command-exit 0.

Gate sweep at `c53513be`: `dispatch-gates --commands` derived 66 families (the same 66 as PR #28828); 66 run, all exit 0 (`dispatch-gates --ran` reads "66 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED", a derived zero). One first ran exit 3 on a prerequisite and was re-run green: `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` (seven packages outside the dogfood closure were unbuilt). The record is `pm-orders/server/28830-gates-ran.txt` in the project files.

Full dogfood battery: not run. The arm is `(widening)` and the title carries no `!`; the two touched test files ran as above.

Changeset `.changeset/28830-layered-read-pair-added-member.md`: `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` patch, both declaration lines. CI families are read from this PR's check-runs, not re-run here.
